title: Migrate container utilization, customer shipments and shipment finance through shared controlled datasets and presets
description: Stage2 reusable family migration; no dedicated controller/designer/exporter or new independent business report. IReportService.GetContainerStatsAsync/GetDynamicContainerStatsReportAsync and GetCustomerShipmentStatsAsync supply existing bounded semantics. DynamicShipmentFinanceReportController and SalesOrderShipmentFinanceReport project read-only shipment/finance evidence using DynamicShipmentFinanceReportRules. Registry entries container-stats, customer-shipment and shipment-finance exist but have no controlled providers/presets. Shared platform adaptation must retain shipment grain and avoid multiplying order-head amounts across one-to-many rows. Use the existing provider contract and generic Excel/PDF exporters. Do not rewrite legacy queries/algorithms or add new business calculations. Do not change schema, migration scripts, production databases, secrets/env, user permissions or unrelated modules. All new implementation is limited to the exact provider/constants/preset/DI/test paths. Dependencies serialize shared constants/preset/DI modifications. Full inventory parity is required before switching old entries.
acceptance_criteria: Migrate the container utilization, customer shipments and shipment finance report family as finite controlled dataset adapters and immutable presets in the existing generic platform; cover every corresponding fixed and dynamic registry entry and original field/grain semantics. Reuse legacy calculations, disclose unsupported capabilities truthfully, and retain all existing routes.

Every catalog, preview and export request revalidates the original menu permission and current-user row/column/data scope. Reject unknown fields/filters, excess date/page bounds and unavailable services with bounded failure results. Preserve currency/unit partitions, null evidence and one-to-many amount cardinality; generic query/export audit stays intact.

Add presets keyed to the corresponding registry entries and live catalog keys, allowing authorized private copies through the existing preset orchestration. Adapter/preset presence means readiness only: never mark parity-passed or switch a legacy route based on declarations or incomplete comparisons.

Add executable ReportConfigurationFulfillmentMigrationTests comparisons between legacy service output and generic preview/Excel/PDF semantics, including paging, empty rows, unauthorized/revoked menus, currency/unit and nullable evidence. Add isolated SQL fixtures guarded to the existing named LocalDB test instance/database, never default production connections; run related tests, safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts. Missing genuine database/browser coverage remains accurately unverified, with no phase completion claim.
implementation_evidence: IReportService.GetContainerStatsAsync/GetDynamicContainerStatsReportAsync and GetCustomerShipmentStatsAsync supply existing bounded semantics. DynamicShipmentFinanceReportController and SalesOrderShipmentFinanceReport project read-only shipment/finance evidence using DynamicShipmentFinanceReportRules. Registry entries container-stats, customer-shipment and shipment-finance exist but have no controlled providers/presets. Shared platform adaptation must retain shipment grain and avoid multiplying order-head amounts across one-to-many rows. Verified registry in src/ERP.Application/DTOs/ReportMigrationRegistryDtos.cs, providers in src/ERP.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs and existing preset manifest in src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.cs. Search existing task history excludes this family: ERP-297 is purchase/supplier and ERP-298 is financial statements/ar-aging.
